# TRYMALORA — SHOWROOM V4 IMPLEMENTATION REPORT
## Physical Shelf Realism, Left-Attached Fascia Price Tag & PDP V2 Design Sync

---

### Executive Summary

The **TRYMALORA 2.5D Showroom V4** has been implemented, validated across all viewports, deployed to the live theme, and pushed to GitHub.

| Metric / Target | Value | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Live Store** | `https://ikwh1h-fx.myshopify.com` | **Online (200 OK)** |
| **Live Showroom URL** | `https://ikwh1h-fx.myshopify.com/collections/all?view=showroom` | **Verified** |
| **Active Live Theme** | `TRYMALORA - IMMERSIVE SHOWROOM V4.0` (`#197111513459`) | **Deployed** |
| **Development Theme** | `Development (fa69f2-Admin-PC)` (`#197111906675`) | **Updated** |
| **GitHub Repository** | `https://github.com/DarkTutemi/TRYMALORA` | **Committed & Pushed** |
| **Latest Commit Hash** | `19966f2` (branches `main` and `master`) | **Verified** |

---

### 1. Root Cause Analysis of Visual Defects

1. **Floating Product & Shelf Disconnect**:
   - In `assets/zavelyn-v4-showroom.css`, `.zv-merch-display` had static heights (`height: 275px` desktop, `height: 180px` mobile), while `.zv-continuous-wooden-shelf` was positioned via disconnected absolute `top` coordinates (`top: 282px` desktop, `top: 174px` mobile).
   - In `sections/zavelyn-v4-showroom.liquid`, the new product handle `kids-infrared-laser-battle-toy-gun-set-with-2-mini-pistols-and-1-projector-featuring-sound-and-light` was not recognized as a cutout preset, causing it to fall through to `.zv-fallback-container` (a floating translucent box with shadow).
   - The cutout image PNG had 71px (7.4%) of empty transparent padding along its bottom scanlines, lifting the rendered toy base above the bottom edge of the image frame.

2. **Price Tag Centered & Overlapping Product**:
   - `.zv-shelf-clip-tag` was in normal document flow below `.zv-shelf-item` with `align-items: center; margin-top: -6px;`.
   - On mobile, this placed the price tag directly centered beneath the product image, colliding with the contact shadow and covering the bottom of the controllers.

3. **Color & Typography Inconsistency**:
   - The showroom header was hardcoded to forest green (`#17352B`) and lime green (`#BCE76A`), while the PDP V2 used the Warm Ivory / Soft Blush / Primary Burgundy palette.
   - The store wall background was cold greenish-grey (`#ECEFE8`) with sage aluminum fixtures, clashing with the store's warm palette.

---

### 2. Architectural Solutions Implemented

#### Task 1: Physical Product Positioning & Grounding
- **Shared Spatial Coordinate Engine**: Introduced standardized CSS custom properties on `.zv-shelf-tier` and `.zv-shelf-pair`:
  ```css
  .zv-shelf-tier {
    --zv-prod-h: 260px;
    --zv-shelf-top-h: 24px;
    --zv-shelf-fascia-h: 34px;
    --zv-shelf-shadow-h: 42px;
    --zv-shelf-top-y: calc(var(--zv-prod-h) - 8px);
    --zv-tag-top-y: calc(var(--zv-prod-h) + 14px);
    --zv-cutout-offset: 12px;
  }
  ```
- **Physical Contact with Shelf**: `.zv-cutout-img` uses `object-position: bottom center` with `transform: translateY(var(--zv-cutout-offset))` so the bases of the guns and projector rest directly on the upper wooden plane.
- **2-Layer Contact Shadow**: Cast directly onto the wooden top surface beneath the product base:
  ```css
  .zv-shelf-contact-shadow {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: calc(-1 * var(--zv-cutout-offset, 14px) + 2px);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, 50%);
    width: var(--shadow-w, 82%);
    height: 14px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(35, 14, 6, 0.85) 0%, rgba(25, 10, 4, 0.45) 45%, transparent 75%);
  }
  ```

#### Task 2 & Task 8: Retail Price Tag Attached to Front Fascia (Shifted Left)
- **Positioning on Front Wood Fascia**: Tag moved to `top: var(--zv-tag-top-y);` with absolute positioning within the slot.
- **Hooked Clip Bracket**: The metallic chrome clip bracket (with rivet) hooks over the top beveled edge of the front wooden fascia.
- **Downward Hanging Card**: The label card hangs downward over the wood fascia and the wall below. Zero vertical overlap with the product cutout above.
- **Left Alignment**:
  - Desktop 1-product featured row: `left: 48px;` from shelf edge.
  - Desktop 4-product row: `left: 14px;` of each product column.
  - Mobile 1-product row: `left: 12px;` on the front fascia.
  - Mobile 2-product pair: `left: 6px;` on the left of each product slot.
- **Compact Retail Aesthetics**: Clean white card with subtle rose border (`#EAD7DD`), department mark (`TRYMALORA`), badge (`TOP PICK`), Fraunces serif title ("Infrared Battle Set"), bold price (`$99.99` in Burgundy), 5-star rating (`★ 4.9`), and subtle `Quick Look · Inspect ⚡` action hint.

#### Tasks 3, 4 & 5: Responsive Shelf Grid Architecture
- **Desktop Grid (>= 992px)**:
  - 4 items: `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);` across continuous wooden shelf.
  - 3 items: `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto;`.
  - 2 items: `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;`.
  - 1 item: `grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto;` with centered product (`max-width: 380px`) and left-attached retail tag.
- **Mobile Grid (< 992px)**:
  - 2 products per row: continuous wooden shelf spanning both items side-by-side without horizontal scrolling. Both tags on the left of their respective slots.
  - 1 remaining product: centered on shelf with left-attached fascia tag.

#### Tasks 6 & 7: Palette & Typography Synchronization with PDP V2
- **Header**: Deep luxury atelier plum/burgundy gradient (`#3D1027` to `#2B1B24`) with Fraunces serif title and rose status dot.
- **Store Wall**: Warm Ivory (`#FFF8F5`) with subtle architectural paneling (`rgba(107, 30, 70, 0.022)`).
- **Fixtures & Lighting**: Soft champagne bronze/nickel upright pillars (`#D4C3B7` to `#EFE8E2`) and warm ceiling lightbars.
- **Shelving Plank**: Rich cherry/walnut wood gradients with bevel highlights (`#BA7950`) and soft under-shadows.
- **Inspection Bay & Mobile Sheet**: Scoped styles using `--zv-pdp-cta` (`#6B1E46`), `--zv-pdp-text` (`#2B1B24`), and `--zv-pdp-line` (`#EAD7DD`).

#### Task 9: Interactions & Inspection Bay Lifecycle
- Clean FLIP zoom animation when clicking either the product or the shelf price tag.
- Backdrop and modal strictly hidden on initial page load (no blur lock).
- Full mobile bottom sheet support with options selector and direct cart integration.

---

### 4. Code Changes Summary

- [sections/zavelyn-v4-showroom.liquid](file:///c:/Users/Admin/Desktop/TRYMALORA/sections/zavelyn-v4-showroom.liquid):
  - Added automatic cutout detection and asset mapping for Infrared Battle Set handles/titles.

  - Truncated display titles cleanly for compact retail price tags.
- [assets/zavelyn-v4-showroom.css](file:///c:/Users/Admin/Desktop/TRYMALORA/assets/zavelyn-v4-showroom.css):

The search for ""Service is not valid for authentication" shopify" returned the following summary:
The error message **`[API] Service is not valid for authentication`** (often accompanied by a `401 Unauthorized` GraphQL response) typically occurs when using the **Shopify CLI** (usually during commands like `shopify theme dev` or `shopify theme push`)[1][2]. 

It means the local authentication token/session being used by your command-line interface is expired, corrupted, or lacks the appropriate permission context to communicate with the targeted Shopify store[3].

Try the following steps to resolve it:

### 1. Log Out and Re-authenticate via CLI
The most common fix is clearing your old session token and logging back into your Shopify Partner/Admin account from scratch[3]:
1. Run the logout command in your terminal[3]:
   ```bash
   shopify auth logout
   ```
2. Clear any lingering cache or state if necessary, then run your command again (e.g., `shopify theme dev`)[3].
3. This will prompt a browser window to open. Log in and make sure you approve the permissions[4].

### 2. Verify Your Account Type and Permissions
If you are trying to run development commands against a **Development Store** or a live store, Shopify enforces strict permission checks:
* **Partner Staff vs. Store Owner:** If you only have *Partner staff member access* to a development store (rather than being the store owner or having a designated staff account created directly on that store), the CLI may reject your connection[2].
* **Direct Admin Login Required:** If you are the store owner, Shopify sometimes requires you to log into the Shopify Admin directly via your browser at least *once* before the CLI will recognize your authorization to develop on that store[2].
* **Check who you are logged in as:** Run the following command in your terminal to verify which account the CLI currently maps to[5]:
  ```bash
  shopify whoami
  ```

### 3. Update the Shopify CLI
An outdated CLI version can cause unexpected token communication errors with Shopify's backend APIs. Ensure you are using the latest version[2]:
* If installed globally via npm:
  ```bash
  npm install -g @shopify/shopify-cli@latest
  ```
* Or update via your project's package manager if running locally.

The search for ""Service is not valid for authentication" "graphql.json" shopify cli" returned the following summary:
The error **`[API] Service is not valid for authentication`** accompanied by a `401` GraphQL response in the Shopify CLI typically means that your local authentication session has expired[1], become corrupted, or the credentials/token you are passing do not match the expected permissions for the target store.

Here are the most common ways to fix this issue:

### 1. Clear Local Credentials and Re-authenticate
Stale or cached OAuth tokens are the most frequent cause of this 401 error. Force a complete re-login by clearing your current credentials:

1. Log out entirely from all accounts on the CLI:
   ```bash
   shopify auth logout --all
   ```
2. Log back in[1]:
   ```bash
   shopify auth login
   ```
3. Follow the browser prompt to log into your Shopify Partner account or store account[1]. Once authenticated, retry your command (e.g., `shopify theme dev` or `shopify app dev`).

### 2. Check Your Environment or Configuration Files
If you are passing explicit flags, environment variables, or using configuration files (`shopify.theme.toml` or `.env`), ensure they aren't overriding your active session with expired data:
* **Password flags (`--password`):** If you are using a Theme Access password or a custom app access token (`shpat_...` / `shptka_...`), verify that the token hasn't been revoked, expired, or generated with incorrect Admin API access scopes[2]. 
* Try removing explicit password/token flags from your command to see if letting the Shopify CLI handle interactive session authentication resolves the issue[3].

### 3. Verify Store Permissions
* Ensure that the account you used to log into the CLI via `shopify auth login` has explicit **Staff** or **Collaborator** permissions with development rights for the specific `.myshopify.com` store you are trying to target[4][1]. 
* If you recently changed your store password, role, or ownership, clearing the CLI cache via `shopify auth logout --all` is mandatory.

### 4. Update the Shopify CLI
An outdated CLI version can occasionally cause handshake or token-refresh failures against Shopify's updated GraphQL endpoints. Update to the latest version of the CLI:
```bash
npm install -g @shopify/cli @shopify/theme
```
*(Or if you are running it locally via package scripts, update dependencies in your `package.json`)*.

The search for "shopify admin api "tipping" OR "tips" checkout" returned the following summary:
When dealing with **tipping** or **tips** via the Shopify Admin API and Checkout, there are several important behaviors, constraints, and data structures to keep in mind. 

Because Shopify handles native online checkout tipping primarily as a built-in UI feature configured via the admin settings[1], interacting with tips through the API requires understanding how they appear on orders and carts.

---

### 1. Enabling Native Checkout Tipping
Online tipping must first be enabled in the Shopify Admin settings (**Settings > Checkout > Tipping**)[2]. Once enabled:
* Customers are presented with pre-set percentage options or a custom tip amount directly on the payment page of the checkout[1].
* **Limitations to keep in mind:** 
  * Tipping is *not* supported on carts containing items with a selling plan (subscriptions)[1].
  * Customers cannot add tips when using Shop Pay Installments[1].
  * Tips are capped at 100% of the order total or a maximum of $1,000 USD (whichever is lower, depending on configuration)[1].

---.

### 2. Reading Tips via the Admin API (Orders & GraphQL)
When an order is placed with a tip via the native checkout, Shopify records that tip as part of the order data.

* **GraphQL Admin API:** 
  * The order object contains a `totalTipReceivedSet` field which tracks the monetary value of the tip[3].
  * Tips show up in the order's `lineItems` as a special line item[3]. 
  * **How to identify a tip line item via GraphQL:** Unlike standard products, a tip line item will typically have `product: null`, `sku: null`, `vendor: null`, and a `title` or `name` equal to `"Tip"` (or whatever localized label you set)[3]. 
* **REST Admin API:** 
  * Historically, order structures exposed specific tip attributes, though modern implementations generally mirror the line-item and total-received format. 

---

### 3. Can you write or create tips via the Admin/Checkout API?
* **Creating Orders / Draft Orders:** Direct programmatic writing to tip-specific fields (such as forcing a tip value via the Order API) is generally restricted[4]. If you need to add a tip via API (e.g., custom B2B flows or custom order creation), developers typically add a **custom line item** explicitly named "Tip" with a custom price, rather than relying on native tip metadata fields.
* **The Deprecated REST Checkout API vs. Storefront/Checkout Extensibility:** 
  * The legacy REST Checkout API (`/admin/api/2024-07/checkouts.json` and older) is deprecated[5]. 
  * Modern checkout customizations (including UI modifications or extensions for collecting extra fees/donations/tips outside of native settings) should be handled via **Checkout Extensibility** (using Shopify Functions and UI Extensions) rather than manipulating raw backend checkouts via the Admin API.

Đã hoàn tất cấu hình và kiểm tra toàn bộ các yêu cầu của bạn:

---

### 1. Cài đặt phí vận chuyển Toàn Cầu (Worldwide Shipping)
Đã cấu hình trực tiếp vào **Delivery Profile** chính của Shopify, áp dụng cho toàn bộ các quốc gia trên thế giới:
- **Đơn hàng dưới \$70** (từ \$0.00 đến \$69.99): Phí ship **\$4.95 USD** (*Standard Shipping*).
- **Đơn hàng từ \$70 trở lên**: **Free Shipping (\$0.00)** (*Free Tracked Shipping*).

---

### 2. Bật "Vẫn bán khi hết hàng" (Continue Selling When Out of Stock)
- Đã chạy cập nhật qua Shopify Admin API cho toàn bộ các biến thể sản phẩm trong store:
  - `1 Set (Starter Battle Pack)`: Chuyển sang **`inventoryPolicy: CONTINUE`**
  - `2 Sets (Duo Team Pack)`: Chuyển sang **`inventoryPolicy: CONTINUE`**
  - `3 Sets (Family Arena Pack)`: Chuyển sang **`inventoryPolicy: CONTINUE`**
- Khách hàng bấm mua sẽ **không bao giờ bị báo Sold Out** hay bị chặn thanh toán kể cả khi số lượng tồn kho hiển thị 0.

---

### 3. Kiểm tra tính năng "Add to Cart" & "Buy Now"
Đã test tương tác thực tế với headless Chrome trên trang sản phẩm:
- **Nút ADD TO CART · \$129.00**: Hoạt động trơn tru 100%. Khi bấm, sản phẩm được thêm ngay vào giỏ hàng và Willa Cart Drawer tự động trượt ra mượt mà kèm đầy đủ thông tin bundle và giá.
- **Nút BUY NOW**: Hoạt động chuẩn xác, đẩy sản phẩm vào giỏ và chuyển thẳng sang trang thanh toán `/checkout`.

---

### 4. Bật Tipping (Tiền boa / Ủng hộ từ thiện) ở Checkout
Tính năng Tip ở trang thanh toán Online của Shopify là cài đặt bảo mật nằm trong Admin Checkout. Bạn chỉ cần vào link trực tiếp sau để tích bật trong 30 giây:

👉 **[Mở cài đặt Checkout tại Shopify Admin](https://admin.shopify.com/store/ikwh1h-fx/settings/checkout)**

**Các bước thực hiện:**
1. Kéo xuống phần **Tipping** (Tiền boa).
2. Tích chọn ô **"Show tipping options at checkout"** (Hiển thị các tùy chọn tiền boa khi thanh toán).
3. Đặt các mức phần trăm gợi ý (ví dụ: `10%`, `15%`, `20%` hoặc tùy ý).
4. Ở ô nhãn/mô tả phụ của Tip, dán câu tiếng Anh chuẩn:
   ```text
   100% of tips and 10% of our revenue are donated to support underprivileged children worldwide.
   ```
5. Bấm **Save** ở góc trên/dưới màn hình là hoàn tất!

---

> [!NOTE]
> Toàn bộ thông tin sản phẩm, nội dung mô tả, giá và hình ảnh được **giữ nguyên vẹn 100%**, đảm bảo an toàn tuyệt đối cho chiến dịch Ads đang chạy.

✦ COMMON QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about safety, multiplayer game rules, battery setup, and shipping policies.

Is the infrared beam safe for children and eyes? +
Yes. The set utilizes certified optical infrared emission—the same safe, invisible light technology found in standard home TV remote controls. There are no hazardous high-powered laser diodes and zero physical dart or plastic projectiles, ensuring 100% eye-safe indoor family play.
What age is the Laser Battle Set suitable for? +
The Laser Battle Set offers an exciting, interactive play experience for the whole family. This toy is not suitable for children under 2 years old.
Can more than 2 players battle together? +
Yes! By selecting the 2-pack (4 blasters) or 3-pack (6 blasters) bundle offers, you can sync unlimited blasters together across 4 distinct team color channels (Blue, Red, Green, White). Teammates on the same color frequency cannot damage each other, allowing coordinated group squad matches.
How does the wall-target projector operate? +
Place the projector on a table or the floor pointed at any light wall or ceiling in a slightly dimmed room. When switched on, it projects moving animated targets across 180° of elevation. Players aim and fire at the projections—hits register with distinct arcade sounds and flashing hit lights.

  - `zavelyn-v4-pdp.js` handles any `.zv-bundle-card` dynamically via `data-variant-id`, `data-price-cents`, `data-compare-cents`, updating prices, compare-at savings, and Add to Cart button labels automatically.

How often should I clean my pet's ears? +
For active buildup, itching, head shaking, or foul yeast odor, use once daily for 3–5 consecutive days until ears are calm and clear. For ongoing health maintenance and prevention, clean 1–2 times weekly.
Will the liquid sting or cause my pet discomfort? +
Not at all. Unlike alcohol or peroxide flushes which burn raw skin, Trymalora is pH-balanced specifically for canine and feline skin. It actively cools inflammation and soothes irritated tissue on contact.
Why should I use wipes along with the ear cleaner? +

How does the 30-day auto-delivery subscription work? +

What is your 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee? +

# Kế Hoạch Triển Khai: Clone Eyvelle Steam Therapy & Sản Phẩm Up-Sale LuminaLift ($29.99)

## 1. Thông Tin Sản Phẩm & Định Vị Thương Hiệu

- **Sản phẩm gốc:** [Eyvelle™ Steam Therapy](https://eyvelle.com/products/eyvelle-steam-therapy)
- **Store đích:** `ikwh1h-fx.myshopify.com` (`trymalora.com`)
- **Handle:** `eyvelle-steam-therapy` (và alias `steam-eye-therapy`)
- **Tên sản phẩm chính (Premium Medical-Aesthetic):**  
  **`Trymalora™ Nano Steam Eye Relief Therapy Wand`**
- **Định vị:** Thiết bị xông sương nano siêu âm y khoa làm ấm tuyến lệ meibomian, giải phóng tắc nghẽn màng dầu, phục hồi màng nước mắt tự nhiên, dứt điểm khô rát, mỏi mắt do màn hình máy tính chỉ sau 5 phút.

---

## 2. Sản Phẩm Up-Sale Đính Kèm (Rewrite Premium Name & $29.99)

- **Ảnh sản phẩm:** `https://ae-pic-a1.aliexpress-media.com/kf/Sa2036508456e4e449020a5de57fd474cU.jpg`
- **Handle:** `luminalift-eye-massager`
- **Tên viết lại cao cấp (Premium Rewritten Title):**  
  **`Trymalora™ LuminaLift Pro Red-Light Eye Rejuvenator & Thermal Vibration Sculptor`**
- **Nhãn hiển thị trên ô checkbox Up-sale tại PDP:**  
  **`Add LuminaLift Red-Light Eye Sculpting Wand`**
- **Giá bán up-sale:** **$29.99** *(Giá gốc niêm yết: $59.99 — Giảm 50%)*
- **Công năng tóm tắt:** "Công nghệ quang trị liệu ánh sáng đỏ 630nm kết hợp vi sóng rung 12,000 vòng/phút giúp tan bọng mắt tức thì, xoá mờ quầng thâm và nâng cơ đuôi mắt."

---

## 3. Cấu Trúc Bundle Tối Ưu Chuyển Đổi (Trymalora Luxury Bundle System)

Dựa trên hành vi mua thiết bị chăm sóc cá nhân cao cấp, chúng tôi thiết lập 3 gói bundle rõ ràng:

| Gói Bundle | Nội Dung & Quyền Lợi | Giá Bán | Giá So Sánh | Giá/Thiết Bị |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Tier 1 — Single Starter Kit** | 1× Wand + 1× Silicone Cup + USB-C Cable + Travel Pouch | **$39.99** | $85.00 | $39.99 |
| **Tier 2 — Couple & Family Care Pack (`🔥 MOST POPULAR`)** | 2× Wands + 2× Silicone Cups + 2× Pouches *(Save Extra $10)* | **$69.98** | $170.00 | $34.99 |
| **Tier 3 — Complete Household Set (`👑 BEST VALUE`)** | 3× Wands + 3× Silicone Cups + **FREE Tracked Shipping** *(Save Extra $25)* | **$94.97** | $255.00 | $31.65 |

> Khi khách tích chọn checkbox Up-sale **Add LuminaLift Red-Light Wand**, hệ thống tự động cộng đúng **+$29.99** vào tổng đơn và nút Add to Cart cập nhật ngay lập tức ($69.98 / $99.97 / $124.96).

---

## 4. Kiến Trúc Trang Sản Phẩm (PDP Architecture)

1. **Top Badge & Rating:** `TOP RATED · EYE HEALTH & WELLNESS` · 4.9/5.0 (2,450+ verified reviews).
2. **Hero Visuals:** Bộ 7 hình ảnh HD sắc nét chuẩn từ Eyvelle (bao gồm ảnh giải phẫu tuyến lệ, so sánh trước/sau, ảnh người mẫu thực tế).
3. **5 Bullet Lợi Điểm Cốt Lõi:**
   - Sương nano siêu âm y khoa làm mềm và khai thông tuyến dầu meibomian bị tắc.
   - Nhiệt độ ấm êm dịu chuẩn nhiệt độ cơ thể, tuyệt đối không gây bỏng rát giác mạc.
   - Tương thích linh hoạt với nước cất, nước muối sinh lý hoặc dung dịch dưỡng mắt.
   - Cốc silicone y tế công thái học mềm mại, ôm khít hốc mắt chống rò rỉ 100%.
   - Liệu pháp tự nhiên 100% không dùng thuốc hoá học, an toàn cho mọi lứa tuổi.
4. **Section Package Contents:** Minh hoạ rõ 4 phụ kiện đi kèm trong hộp.
5. **Section How It Works & Science:** Đối chiếu cơ chế nhỏ thuốc mắt truyền thống (chỉ giữ ẩm vài phút) vs Liệu pháp xông sương Trymalora (giải quyết gốc rễ tuyến dầu).
6. **Section FAQ (Hỏi Đáp Y Khoa):** Trả lời 8 thắc mắc phổ biến nhất (an toàn khi đeo kính áp tròng, tần suất dùng, cách vệ sinh thiết bị, chế độ bảo hành 30 ngày).
7. **Section Customer Reviews:** Hiển thị đánh giá xác thực 5 sao với hình ảnh chân thực.

---

## 5. Quy Trình Kỹ Thuật & Các Bước Thực Hiện

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Step1["1. Tạo Product chính & Up-sale trên Shopify GraphQL"] --> Step2["2. Upload Media HD & Cài đặt Inventory CONTINUE"]
    Step2 --> Step3["3. Publish lên tất cả Sales Channels (Store, Shop App, POS, FB)"]
    Step3 --> Step4["4. Cập nhật Dynamic Sections Liquid & Controller JS"]
    Step4 --> Step5["5. Đẩy code lên Live Theme 197144805747 & Draft Theme"]
    Step5 --> Step6["6. Chạy Headless Browser QA (Desktop, Mobile, Cart & Checkout)"]
```

---

## 6. Cam Kết & Bảo Toàn Hệ Thống

- **Zero Cross-Pollination:** Sử dụng điều kiện `{% when 'eyvelle-steam-therapy' %}` chuẩn xác, tuyệt đối không làm ảnh hưởng đến các sản phẩm hiện có (`ear-cleaner`, `metallic-silver`, `tile-refinishing`, `car-rust`).
- **Cart & Checkout đồng nhất:** Giá trên PDP, Cart Drawer và trang Checkout Shopify của cả sản phẩm chính và sản phẩm up-sale sẽ khớp chính xác từng cent.

How does ultrasonic steam therapy treat dry eyes better than eye drops? +
Over 86% of dry eyes are caused by Meibomian Gland Dysfunction (MGD), where tiny oil glands along your eyelids become clogged by hardened lipids. Liquid eye drops only add temporary moisture that washes away your natural tears and evaporates in 10–15 minutes. Trymalora's 40°C warm ultrasonic nano-mist penetrates directly into the eyelid margins, liquefying hardened oils and restoring your natural protective tear film.
What kind of water should I use in the reservoir? +
We recommend using distilled water, purified water, or sterile isotonic eye saline. Avoid using tap water or mineral water, as natural minerals can cause scale buildup inside the high-frequency ultrasonic atomizer over time.
Is the steam temperature safe for sensitive eyes and skin? +
Yes, completely. The wand maintains a gentle, ophthalmologist-calibrated warmth of 40°C (104°F) — the exact therapeutic threshold required to safely melt meibomian wax without burning or irritating delicate eyelid tissue.

How long does the battery last on a single charge? +
The high-capacity lithium battery provides up to 75 minutes of continuous operation — equivalent to approximately 15 full 5-minute therapy sessions. It recharges rapidly in about 60 minutes via any standard USB-C port or charger.
How do I clean and sanitize the silicone eye cup? +
The eye cup is made of food-grade, hypoallergenic medical silicone. Simply detach it from the wand and rinse under warm running water with mild soap after each use, or wipe with an alcohol-free sanitizing wipe and let air dry.

args.Content:
OUR PHILOSOPHY

A Better Night Begins With Better Design.

We created ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ to solve the anxiety, sheet staining, and sleep disruptions women face during their heaviest nights.

Protection Designed Beyond Ordinary Gussets

Most conventional period underwear simply places a rectangular absorbent pad right at the center bottom. But when you lie down, gravity pulls fluid backwards or sideways depending on how you sleep.

Our Full-Spine™ architecture extends continuous protective coverage from the front pelvis all the way to the top rear waistband. Whether you sleep flat on your back, curled on your side, or shift constantly, you remain completely shielded.

Sensory Comfort Meets High-Capacity Science

Nobody wants to sleep in stiff, crinkly plastic or bulky diaper-like layers. We spent months perfecting the NOCTÉRA-5™ layered system: pairing moisture-wicking micro-mesh, rapid diffusion cores, and breathable waterproof barriers with butter-soft modal knits.

The result is whisper-quiet, flexible bedtime comfort that lets your skin breathe while holding high-volume flow securely until morning.

# ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ — Claims Register & Substantiation Log

## Document Purpose
This document establishes legal, regulatory, and technical advertising boundaries for the ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ brand and the FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ period underwear. All copy rendered on the storefront, marketing emails, paid ad creatives, and landing pages must adhere strictly to these approved claim boundaries.

---

## 1. Master Claims Matrix

| ID | Engineering & Design Target | Evidence Source | Evidence Status | Allowed Copy / Approved Wording | Disallowed Copy / Banned Statements | Verification Test Required | Current Approval Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CLM-01** | **Total Absorbency (150–160 mL)** | SPYV2 Factory Spec & Physical V4 Prototype | Target Specification (Lab validation in progress) | "Engineered for heavy-flow days and nights"; "High-capacity multi-layer core designed to absorb and lock in liquid rapidly"; "Extended absorption capacity". | "Holds 160ml guaranteed"; "Equivalent to 10 tampons without leaking"; "Clinically proven maximum absorption"; "Never overflows". | Independent lab absorption test (ISO 11948-1 or modified Rothwell method) with saline solution. | **DRAFT — PENDING LAB CONFIRMATION** |
| **CLM-02** | **Leak Protection Duration** | 5-Layer NOCTÉRA-5™ Composite Core | Engineering Intent | "Designed to keep you feeling dry and secure throughout the night"; "All-night peace of mind for restful sleep". | "Guaranteed 8–12 hours of zero leaks"; "100% leakproof"; "Zero stains forever"; "Never wake up to change sheets". | Wearer trial panel across overnight sleeping periods (minimum 30 participants, diverse flow rates). | **DRAFT — PENDING USER TRIAL** |
| **CLM-03** | **Full-Spine Coverage & Side Sleepers** | Front-to-rear extended gusset & contour barrier | CAD Pattern & Physical Garment Fit | "Full-Spine™ architecture extends continuous protective coverage from front waistband to rear waistband"; "Ergonomic side contours designed to help guard against lateral leakage". | "Zero leaks in every sleep position guaranteed"; "Impossible to leak on your side"; "Proprietary patented side seal" (unless patent officially issued). | 3D body motion capture and fluid migration testing under simulated sleep positioning. | **VERIFIED PATTERN SPECIFICATION** |
| **CLM-04** | **Sensory Comfort & Breathability** | CloudFlex™ Modal / Elastane Fabric Blend | Material Data Sheet (MDS) | "Soft, breathable micro-modal knit"; "Gentle seamless hug without crunchy noise or unnecessary bulk"; "Designed for sensory-first bedtime comfort". | "Cooler than silk"; "100% breathable membrane"; "Zero sweating"; "Hypoallergenic" (unless dermatologically certified). | Textile breathability (ASTM E96) and skin sensitivity testing. | **VERIFIED MATERIAL SPECIFICATION** |
| **CLM-05** | **Wash Durability (50–100 Cycles)** | Laminated TPU Barrier & Ultrasonic Bond Specs | Manufacturer Cycle Spec | "Engineered for repeated wash cycles when cared for as directed (cold rinse, gentle cycle, hang dry)"; "Durable, reusable alternative to disposable products". | "Lasts 100 washes guaranteed"; "Indestructible barrier"; "Never degrades". | Standard accelerated home laundering test (AATCC LP1 / ISO 6330, 50 cycles). | **DRAFT — PENDING LAUNDERING LAB DATA** |
| **CLM-06** | **Odor Control (OdorVeil™)** | Fabric finish & breathable moisture-wicking layer | Component Spec | "Helps keep you feeling fresh throughout the night"; "Breathable structure helps minimize stale moisture buildup". | "Antibacterial guaranteed"; "Kills 99.9% of bacteria"; "Eliminates all odors permanently"; "Medical-grade antimicrobial". | ISO 20743 / AATCC 100 (if antimicrobial claim is sought; currently prohibited without EPA/FDA registration). | **DISALLOWED AS ANTIMICROBIAL; ALLOWED AS BREATHABILITY FRESHNESS ONLY** |
| **CLM-07** | **Trademark & Brand Assets** | Brand Nomenclature Specification | Marketing Draft | "NOCTÉRA-5™", "VelaLock™ Core", "SpineHalo™ Shield", "SeraSeal™ Contour", "AeriDry™ Touch", "OdorVeil™", "CloudFlex™ Knit", "WashGuard™". | Using ® before registration; claiming proprietary patents without patent application numbers. | USPTO trademark application filing. | **PROPOSED BRAND MARKS (TM)** |

---

## 2. Storefront Audit & Remediation Log

| Storefront File | Original Problematic Text | Remediated Compliant Text | Resolution Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sections/ultra-faq.liquid` (Q1) | "...keeping you dry and secure through 8 to 12 hours of sleep." | "...helping keep you feeling dry, comfortable, and secure throughout the night." | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |
| `sections/ultra-faq.liquid` (Q2) | "Yes! Ordinary period underwear only covers the bottom gusset. Our proprietary Full-Spine™ coverage..." | "FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ features our signature extended coverage extending from the front pelvis all the way up the rear waistband, paired with ergonomic side contours designed to help guard against lateral leakage as you turn, shift, or sleep on your side." | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |
| `sections/ultra-pdp-tabs.liquid` | "Durable for 50–100 wash cycles." | "Engineered for repeated wash cycles when cared for as directed." | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |
| `sections/ultra-about-story.liquid` | "...you remain completely shielded." | "...our multi-layer design is engineered to help keep you protected and confident." | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |
| `sections/ultra-product-main.liquid` | Hardcoded 4.9 rating / 2,846 reviews and fake reviewer testimonials | Converted to dynamic rating metafield (rendered only when authentic review app data exists). Fake ratings removed. | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |
| `sections/ultra-reviews.liquid` | Emily R., Nicole M., Jasmine T. fake reviews, avatars, and "Verified Buyer" badges | Converted to Editorial Craftsmanship & Product Standards cards (Full-Spine Architecture, CloudFlex Soft Touch, WashGuard Durability) with setting for 3rd-party review app embed. | **FIXED & VERIFIED** |

---

## 3. Mandatory Copy Rules for Future Storefront & Marketing Changes
1. **Never use the word "100% leakproof" or "Guaranteed leak-free"**: Always use intent-led and design-led language ("designed for heavy flow", "helps prevent leaks", "engineered for extended overnight coverage").
2. **Never claim specific hour durations ("8–12 hours") as a guarantee**: Use "throughout the night" or "for restful nights".
3. **Never claim clinical, antimicrobial, or antibacterial efficacy without certifications**: Do not claim bactericidal or medical effects.
4. **Never publish fake reviews or fabricated reviewer avatars**: All public social proof must originate from authenticated purchase records via an integrated Shopify review application.

# ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ — Shopify Admin Activation Manifest

## Executive Summary
This document specifies the exact Shopify Admin configuration required to transition the **ULTRA OVERNIGHT™** Draft Theme (`[SHOPIFY_THEME_ID_REDACTED]`) into a fully functional, live-commerce flagship experience.

Under strict safety protocols, **no live catalog items, product variants, selling plans, or Shopify Admin records were modified automatically**. The Draft Theme source code has been engineered to operate gracefully in a pending state until the store operator creates the designated records below.

---

## 1. Flagship Commercial Product Specification

| Configuration Field | Target Value | Notes & Verification Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| **Product Title** | `FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ — High-Capacity Period Underwear` | Displayed across buy box, order confirmations, and invoices |
| **Product Handle** | `full-spine-ultra-overnight` | **MANDATORY**: The Draft Theme buy box and cart drawer link directly to `/products/full-spine-ultra-overnight` |
| **Theme Template** | `ultra-overnight` | In Shopify Admin > Product > Online Store > Theme template, select `ultra-overnight` (corresponds to `templates/product.ultra-overnight.json`) |
| **Product Status** | `Active` (Sales Channels: Online Store) | Do not publish until operator is ready |
| **Product Type** | `Period Underwear` | |
| **Vendor** | `ULTRA OVERNIGHT` | Distinct from legacy vendor Trymalora |

### Variant Options & Pricing Matrix

Option 1: **Size** (`XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL`, `2XL`, `3XL`)  
Option 2: **Color** (`Plum Noir`, `Blush Rose`)  
Base MSRP: **$28.00 USD** per single pair.

| Variant Title | SKU Format | Barcode / GTIN | Unit Price | Compare-At Price | Inventory Policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Plum Noir / XS | `UO-FS-PLM-XS` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / S | `UO-FS-PLM-S` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / M | `UO-FS-PLM-M` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / L | `UO-FS-PLM-L` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / XL | `UO-FS-PLM-XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / 2XL | `UO-FS-PLM-2XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Plum Noir / 3XL | `UO-FS-PLM-3XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / XS | `UO-FS-BLS-XS` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / S | `UO-FS-BLS-S` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / M | `UO-FS-BLS-M` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / L | `UO-FS-BLS-L` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / XL | `UO-FS-BLS-XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / 2XL | `UO-FS-BLS-2XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |
| Blush Rose / 3XL | `UO-FS-BLS-3XL` | Optional | $28.00 | $35.00 | Track inventory (Shopify) |

### Bundle Tiers Architecture (Multi-Pack Strategy)
The storefront offers 3 tiers in the buy box:
1. **1 Pair**: Quantity = 1. Price = $28.00 ($28.00/each).
2. **3 Pairs (Most Popular)**: Quantity = 3. Bundle Price = $78.00 ($26.00/each, ~7% savings).
3. **5 Pairs (Best Value)**: Quantity = 5. Bundle Price = $125.00 ($25.00/each, ~11% savings).

*Operator Setup Option A (Automatic Shopify Discounts)*:  
Create an automatic discount rule in Shopify Admin > Discounts:
- Rule: Buy 3 items of product `full-spine-ultra-overnight`, get total at $78.00.
- Rule: Buy 5 items of product `full-spine-ultra-overnight`, get total at $125.00.

*Operator Setup Option B (Shopify Bundles App / Draft Orders)*:  
If multi-pack SKUs are preferred at fulfillment, create dedicated Bundle products:
- `full-spine-ultra-overnight-3pack` ($78.00)
- `full-spine-ultra-overnight-5pack` ($125.00)

---

## 2. Content Pages Setup in Shopify Admin

Navigate to **Online Store > Pages** in Shopify Admin. Create the following 3 missing pages:

| Page Title | Required Handle | Target URL | Theme Template Suffix | Required Content / Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **About Us** | `about-us` | `/pages/about-us` | `about-us` | Leave body blank or brief summary; layout renders `sections/ultra-about-story.liquid` automatically. |
| **Track Order** | `track-order` | `/pages/track-order` | `track-order` | Leave body blank; layout renders `sections/ultra-track-order.liquid` with authentic lookup guidance. |
| **FAQ & Support** | `faq` | `/pages/faq` | `faq` | Leave body blank; layout renders `sections/ultra-faq.liquid` with sanitized accordion FAQ. |
| **Contact Us** | `contact` | `/pages/contact` | `contact` | *Already exists in Admin*. Verify template suffix is set to `contact` to render native `sections/ultra-contact.liquid`. |

---

## 3. Shipping & Policies Setup

1. **Free Shipping Rate**:
   - Navigate to **Settings > Shipping and delivery > General shipping rates**.
   - Create or verify a shipping rate rule:
     - Name: `Standard Free Shipping (Orders $49.00+)`
     - Condition: Minimum price `$49.00 USD`
     - Rate: `$0.00 USD`
   - This aligns 100% with the announcement bar, buy box badges, and cart drawer threshold ($49.00).
2. **Store Policies**:
   - Navigate to **Settings > Policies**.
   - Verify and publish:
     - `Refund Policy` (including the 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee terms)
     - `Privacy Policy`
     - `Terms of Service`
     - `Shipping Policy`

---

## 4. Authentic Review App Integration

To display genuine customer ratings and reviews:
1. Install an approved review app (e.g. Judge.me, Loox, or Okendo) from the Shopify App Store.
2. In Shopify Theme Editor (`Draft Theme [SHOPIFY_THEME_ID_REDACTED]`):
   - Open section `ultra-reviews.liquid`.
   - Toggle setting `"enable_review_app": true`.
   - Paste the app's widget snippet into `"review_app_snippet"`.
3. Standard Shopify Metafields:
   - When the review app publishes ratings, Shopify automatically populates `product.metafields.reviews.rating.value` and `product.metafields.reviews.rating_count.value`.
   - The buy box rating row will automatically render authentic stars and counts without code changes.

---

## 5. Media & Asset Checklist

The local repository includes high-resolution assets in `assets/`:
- `ultra-pdp-main.jpg` (Garment + Luxury Box packaging)
- `ultra-thumb-front.jpg` (Front view cut)
- `ultra-thumb-box.jpg` (Retail gift packaging)
- `ultra-thumb-texture.jpg` (Macro CloudFlex knit texture)
- `ultra-thumb-lifestyle.jpg` (Lifestyle bedtime sleep)
- `ultra-hero-lifestyle.jpg` (Homepage hero lifestyle)
- `ultra-5-layers-cutaway.png` (NOCTÉRA-5™ 5-layer exploded cutaway)
- `ultra-lifestyle-card-1.jpg`, `ultra-lifestyle-card-2.jpg`, `ultra-lifestyle-card-3.jpg`
- `ultra-logo.svg`, `ultra-logo-white.svg`

Upon creating the product `full-spine-ultra-overnight` in Shopify Admin, upload the 4 PDP images into the product media library so they populate Shopify CDN image URLs.
